Recover a plate by reviewing its dish or tissue boundaries

Source: R/recovery.R
retry_funmel_dish.Rd

retry_funmel_dish() uses three outer-rim clicks to correct the dish circle and reruns automatic tissue segmentation. recover_funmel_plate() additionally collects reviewed polygons for TL, TR, BR, BL and, on confrontations, the whole central fungus. Finish each polygon with right-click/Esc. These are optional recovery tools for photographs whose automatic masks fail visual review.

Usage

retry_funmel_dish(
  path,
  dish_diameter_mm,
  centre = c("fungus", "none"),
  dish = NULL,
  output_dir = NULL,
  max_dim = 1200,
  n_spots = 5,
  spot_radius_mm = 0.4,
  n_boot = 200,
  flat_field = TRUE,
  edge_exclude_mm = 0.1
)

recover_funmel_plate(
  path,
  dish_diameter_mm,
  centre = c("fungus", "none"),
  output_dir = NULL,
  max_dim = 1200,
  dish = NULL,
  polygons = NULL,
  n_spots = 5,
  spot_radius_mm = 0.4,
  n_boot = 200,
  flat_field = TRUE,
  edge_exclude_mm = 0.1
)

Arguments

path

One original photograph, not a ZIP or QC figure.

dish_diameter_mm

Verified outer dish diameter in millimetres.

centre

"fungus" for a confrontation, "none" for its control.

dish

Optional c(x,y,r) in working-image pixels; otherwise click three rim points.

output_dir

New output directory; default creates a new folder in the home directory.

max_dim

Working image resolution, used again when applying the annotation.

n_spots, spot_radius_mm

Optional spot sampling settings.

n_boot

Number of spatial bootstrap replicates.

flat_field

Whether to request illumination correction.

edge_exclude_mm

Margin excluded from colour measurements in mm.

polygons

Named list of x/y vertex matrices. NULL collects interactive outlines.

Value

A funmel_result with annotation and recovery_dir. New measurement CSVs, annotation RDS, result RDS, QC PNG and session information are saved.

Details

Whole central fungal extent includes visible connected hyphal growth. Dense core and peripheral growth are not separated by manual polygons; corresponding hyphal-subregion summaries remain unavailable. Invisible or overlapping tissue cannot be recovered by inventing boundaries. Corrected diameters depend on a verified physical dish diameter and the selected outer rim.

The returned annotation can be saved and passed to analyze_plate(annotation=) or to run_experiment(corrections=list(plate_id=annotation)). Use the actual metadata plate ID as the list name. File checksum, resolution, diameter and centre model must match. Rerunning replaces the saved image-analysis run; copy the project folder first if the original run must be retained.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
photo <- file.choose() # Select an original JPG.
fixed <- retry_funmel_dish(photo, dish_diameter_mm = 90, centre = "fungus")
# Use 90 only for a measured 90-mm outer rim. If tissue masks remain wrong:
fixed <- recover_funmel_plate(photo, dish_diameter_mm = 90, centre = "fungus")
} # }
